# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Which to pick:**
- **Best overall:** Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand, about $80–$98.
- **Fastest and most premium:** Nomad Stand One Max, $169, no power adapter.
- **Best value:** ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Station, about $40.
- **Fast charging and fits in a bag:** Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable 25W, $129.99.
- **Fast charging with a coupon:** ESR CryoBoost 25W, about $82 with code PARTNER18.

## 🏆 Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand ($80–$109)
This is WIRED's top pick after testing 30+ models. It's a chrome "tree" that holds the iPhone and Apple Watch up in the air, with an AirPods spot on the base. The phone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy mode.
- **Charging:** 15 W iPhone, fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 or newer
- **In the box:** 36 W power supply
- **Warranty:** 2 years
- **Price:** WIRED lists it at $98 from Belkin, $90 at Amazon and **$80 at Best Buy**
- **Buy:** Use the retailer links in [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/). My search results didn't include a direct product page.

## ⚡ Fastest and most premium: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)
- **Charging:** Qi2 25 W for the iPhone and fast Apple Watch charging
- **Design:** Glossy, piano-black finish with a heavy base, so you can lift the phone off with one hand
- **Catch:** No power adapter is included. You'll need one rated at 40 W, such as Nomad's $25 40 W Slim Adapter.
- **Buy:** Through the Nomad link in [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## 💰 Best value: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station (about $40, normally $80)
WIRED calls it "by far the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1" it has tested.
- **Charging:** 15 W magnetic iPhone pad
- **In the box:** 33 W brick and cable
- **Design:** Compact, and works with StandBy mode
- **Warranty:** 1 year
- **Buy:** Through the Amazon link in [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## 🧳 Fast charging that also travels: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W ($129.99)
- **Charging:** 25 W iPhone and fast Apple Watch charging
- **Design:** Lifts the iPhone more than 70 mm off the desk, the tallest and most adjustable foldable [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html) has tested
- **In the box:** 45 W adapter with US, UK and EU plugs
- **Buy:** Through the retailer links in Macworld's review or [WIRED's travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

## ❄️ Fast charging with a coupon: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1, Qi2.2 25W (about $82)
- **Charging:** 25 W with an active cooling fan, which you can switch off at night
- **In the box:** 50 W adapter
- **Price:** $99.99 at ESR. The code **PARTNER18** takes off $17.99, which brings it to about $82. Dealectric says it tested the code in ESR's cart on Oct 23, and the code expires Dec 31, 2026.
- **Buy:** [Dealectric link to ESR](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission.
- **Warranty and returns:** 30-day returns. The warranty is 12 months, or 24 if you register with ESR.
- **Caveats:** WIRED found the plastic build "doesn't feel premium." It also says the 25 W speed "probably isn't worth it" if you mostly charge overnight.

## Tips before you buy
- **Do you need 25 W?** It only works with the iPhone 16 or 17 series (some models), so check your exact model. Older iPhones charge at 15 W anyway. If you charge overnight, a 15 W stand like the Belkin or the cheaper ESR is plenty.
- **Check your AirPods case.** It has to support wireless charging to work on the third pad.

If you tell me your iPhone model and your budget, I can narrow this to one pick.
